explication: Screenity is a Chrome screen-recording and annotation extension. Its main workflow is configuring a capture in the extension UI, starting and controlling capture through the background process, recording media locally or through the cloud recorder, then playing, editing, and exporting the result. The README also documents camera effects, drawing and blur tools, alarms, and Google Drive saving. The tree and sampled handlers support the major components, but many runtime links are not shown in the excerpts; uncertain wiring is omitted.
